meta.name: exec-briefing-memo
meta.description: Decision needed + recommendation + evidence + tradeoffs, 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从长篇材料提炼决策要点
copy.tagline_en: Condense complex materials into a one-page decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly distill key decision points from lengthy materials

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把会议纪要、调研或数据等复杂材料，提炼成一页高管决策简报，包含决策点、明确建议、关键事实、权衡表、风险缓解和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当用户提供会议记录、销售反馈、产品数据等材料，并要求输出决策简报或一页 memo 时触发；也适用紧急决策、董事会审批等场景。

say.text: 把这份会议纪要压成一页决策简报，给出建议和风险。
say.note: 默认生成 board-memo 风格简报。

say.text: 基于这些销售数据写高管简报，要明确推荐和权衡表。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude distills complex materials like meeting notes, research, or data into a one-page executive briefing memo with decision point, recommendation, key facts, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides meeting notes, sales feedback, product data, etc., and asks for a decision memo; also fits urgent decisions or board approval.

say_en.text: Turn this meeting note into a one-page decision memo with recommendation and risks.
Write an executive briefing from these sales figures, with a clear recommendation and tradeoffs.
say_en.note: Falls back to board-memo if no style is specified.

say_en.text: This is an urgent incident review; create the briefing in decision-command style.
say_en.note: Opts into the dark command-center template.
